name: Manaka Wakaba
source:
"[i]Um... I've thought it through carefully, and I've made my decision![/i]"

Through a certain incident, she becomes connected to the Astronomy Club.
Though somewhat shy and introverted, she's sincere and has a strong sense of responsibility.
Once she sets her mind on something, she sees it through to the end.

Class: Hinamori Academy, Class 2-4
Height: 156cm
Birthday: July 11th
Likes: Cute things, cats
Dislikes: Frivolity, bugs
